nhakwonho hi'a nvtakatsiwehseli vlha ilvhiyu yitsvkathahe'i utli witsilohi uyo titsilvwhstanehi
nahski iyuhsti nani'v khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anathvkihskehsti ale nahski nanatvnehehsti akhahthanha'i ahskaya totakatsiyalilohsthani nahski nvyohi tsunhehskehe'i
nani'vnho khilo hi'a tsinitsiwe'a anatvkihskehsti nahskinho nanatvnehvna ikehsehsti uneku ahskaya tikekatlilohstohti kehsehsti nahski noyuhi tsunhehskehe'i
hi'ano nulhsthane'i nahski tsihsa uhskwa'tv nahski nikawehskv'i unihskwanikohse tateyhohvhskv'i
nhakwono tsukhso'ahsv uhsahilhv'i unitsathi kvwahstawatvhse'i
tsihsanho utoyanvhitv uhsvnhile'i katanvthvli tsatanvkalvtv kehsehsti uwohsele'i khilakwonho iyvtv atayhehski utlvkv utanvkalvhe'i
hi'anho tsihsa nuwehsele'i kha lhehsti khilo tsihinonheli henakwohskini witsakowhahtv atsilvkelhohi ale alhskolhvhtohti whihvka mohsi unhetsv alhskolhvhtohti nahski unatolehohihstohti
nhakwono tsihsa kekwani wi'uluhtsv uluhtsele ahskohihkkwi aniyawhihski tithinhitohi uhstiyethane'i
hi'a nuwehsel'i tsakvwiyuhi tsinvhsitahsti kanka tikwenvhsv utlvka ulvtalv'vhska utsathanvhi akilhiyoka
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i takehsi tatsinvwanehsi

ayvyhenho tikwatanelhohtikwo ale takikhaha aniyawhihski nahski tekvkwanelohto'i khilonho hena tsiyohsi eko'i nvwatalenho ehena tsiyohsi ti'eko'i tsinvhsitahstino hi'a nhatvka tsiyohsi nahski natvneho'i
tsihsanho uthvkanv uhskwanikohse'i ale hi'a nituwehsele nvtakvwahstawatvtv utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha vlha nahskwo ihsili tuto'v nahski ika'i kohiyuhti kehsv yakiwahthv
ale hi'a nitsvwehseha unitsathi tikhalvkv ale wutelikv ititlv tinilohskehsti ale itsulaha anan'vhskehsti ekwahami ale ehsiki ale tsekakwi kalvlati ehi nanha ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i
uhsvnho nulhsthanv unitsathe anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwahthinhohele'i tunukowhihsenho anihskina khanekvkwo khvhtihske'i ale nikatv tsunitlvki tunhvwane'i
tsihsanho tukohv unitsathi yvwi kvwatlawihstihskv'i unhetse ihskonv wunilohihstiyi
nvwatalenho uhstawatitohi hi'a nuwehsele'i tsakvwiyuhi ikvyi kena tsinihsanhuka etota
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehale'i hskihstawatuka unanelkinho tsuniyohuhsvhi taninihsihskehsti tsunatseli tsuniyohuhsvhi
kvnhiyukwonho utsathi uyhi'lolhe unole itali tsiyuyeno ama talhstilhanekv uwulhv'vhske'i ahseno ikalhihekwo
kvwahstawatitohinho kvwaluhtshele kvwayehsthane'i hi'a nikvwawehsele'i tsakvwiyuhi hskihstelv tayotsathsvnhikwo
anihskayanho unihskwanikohse'i hi'a nuniwehse'i kato uhsti hi'a ahskaya nahskwoyhenho unole ale vtali ikvwohiyuhvhska

ihskonitilvnho wuluhtsv kakihsini unatselikohi anithali anihskina tikvwaniya'i tekvwatlohse'i tatanihsahv tsuninukotse'i utsathanvhi uninhalvhiyu kehse'i nahski vlha khilo na'nha kvwalohihsti yikehse'i
kehinho iyvtv tinetohe unitsathi hsunatalki hsihkwa analhstayvnhitohe'i
tsiyuhinho utsanv tuwehsohtse'i uwahsvnho uwetuhv wuluhtse'i
tsihsanho akahthahe nuhstv anatanthehskv'i hi'anho nituwehsel'i katonho uyo itsatanhvhtheha titsinawhiyi'
tulenhvnho tsuwenvhsv wulohse'i
unitsathinho unikohv unihskwanikohse'i ale unilvkwhothane unelhanvhi nahski tsulhskolvhtanelvhi nahski iyuhsti tsunilvwhstanetiyi yvwi
tsihsan nanha utanvhsv ukohvki ahskaya matu tsuto'itv uwolhvki ayelhi akhuyvhtiyi hi'an nuwehselvki hskihstawatuka tulenvnho uhstawatvhsvki
hi'ano nulhsthanvki kankv alihstayvhvhskv kaltsote kvniyukwo unitsathvki atelv anikihsitohi ale anihskana uniluhtsv unanhihtlvnvki aninvhtlha'v tsihsa ale kvwhstawatitohi
tsihsano uthvkanv hi'a nituwehselvki nitunitlvkvna vlha utulhvhti yinunalhstanheho titanhvwihski tsunitlvkihskini
vlha ale khilo itse yikalhahstlvtihsko uwethi anhuwokihi kalahstlvtvyhenho yvkatsakalvta anhuwo utatsakalvhvnho utli ekwohiyu yinikalhsta

vtlha ale itse kikake'atithahsti tsuwethi tihsulvhtv yitanitlihstihsko'i tihsutlvhtvyhenho yittatsaklv ale kikake'atithahsti yatsewoki tihsutlvhtvno ytayoki itsehskini kikake'atithahsti titse tihsulhvht tanitlihstihsko'i itsulanho tunihskwanikoto'i
tsihsanho tulenhv uhstawatvhsvki ale nahskwo kvwahstawatitohi
kvniyukwonho akeyhv utlvki kikv uwenv'ehi thalatu tsutethiyvta ikvwalhsthanvhi onhititlv uluhihstanelvki kataluyathv unhuwa'v uhsvnhelvki
tsihsanho nukvwiyuhsateki kanelv uluhtsv ale tukohv tinitselhuhihski ale yvwi taniykv'i
ketsinukowhihsvnho yvwi uyvlhvki uwoyeni uniyvhvki akeyhutsano tulenhvki
nahskino hi'a tunotsalhohthshitolv'i nahnha nikvnathv tuyelihsitolvki
tsihsanho nanha uta'nvhsv anithali tinikhewi anihskaya kvwhstawatvhsvki unelhuhkvki hi'a naniwehskvki hskinitoliki nihi tewi uwetsi
kalihtsotenho uyvlhv tinikhewi kvwaluhtselvki tsihsanho hi'a nituwehselvki ihstohiyuhvhskahsko yeli nahski ikvkwatvneti kehsv'i' hi'a nikvwawehselvki v'v tsakvwiyuhi
ahsenho unatanvhsvkwo tuninotsalhanvki nanha nikvnathv'i
ahskinanho atsinukowhsv uwakhewi uwonihsvki unitsathinho unihskwanikohsvki hi'a nniwehsvki vtlha ilvhiyu nahski iyuhsti akohvhi yiki ihsiliyi
ahsenho anikwalihsi hi'a nuniwehsvki anihskina unatseli ukvwiyuhi kvhtiha tsitekanukowhihska anihskina

tsihsanho nika'v tsuthvn tekatuhv ale tsuhsti tkatuhv uwetolvki tateyhohvhskvki tsunilaw'ihstiyi ale altsitohvhskvki ohstv khanohetv kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv khanohehskvki ale tekhanvwihskv nika'v tunitlvkv ale nika'v vyhuki yvwi uniyhi'litehv'i
tukohvnho unitsathi yvwi tuwetolihthsvki utak'alhstohtihskvki wanakwo tanilokv'i ale unatikaleyotsvhi kehsv'i nahskiya awhi uninotena nehvna tsikehso unikhahthiya
nahski iyuhsti etsithayohsi uloketv tsunvhstiyi tsunilvwhihstanehi ukahthvnatsel'i
wituyhanvhvno thalatu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi tunhelv anihskina tsuninukowhihstiyi ale tsunatanhvwotiyi nika'v tunitlvkv ale nika'v vyuki
hi'anho nahski nuhsti tunato'v thalatu iyanitv ketsinvhsitv ikvyiyi hsawani kwita tsanohseho'i enitino nahskikwo unhvlhi tsimino tsekwiti uwetsi tsanino nahskikwo unhvlhi
kwilkinho watalamino taminho matunho atelv akihsitohi tsiminho elikwi uwetsi lekwiyano tatiya tsanohseho'i
sawaninho akenaniti tsutahsinho ihskalati nahski tsihsa tsulonuhelhvki
nahski hi'a thalatu iyanitv tsihsa tunvhsvki tunhetselvnho hi'a nituwehselvki tsunatalenhvtv yvwi tinehv ititlv lhehsti witsilohsvki ale hsameli anehi tunituhv lehsti itsiyvlhvki
awhihskini unalenahitv ihsil hsitanelv kehsv titsiwhatvhuka
tsunitlvki tetsinhvwihskehsti atayhehski tsunitlvki tetsinvkalihskehsti tsuniyohuhsvhi tetsaletihskehsti anihskina tetsinukowhihskehsti ahsekwo etsinelvhi ahsekwo itsatanhehehsti
lhehsti tetsatatlohv yitsatanelhehsti talonike atelv ale unekv atelv ale vtsayi
ale tekalhohti ale thali titsanhuwo ale tilahsulo ale titolanvhsti tsulvwhstanehiyhenho uwhahthvhti kehso ulhstayhvhti
ilvhitlvnho uthvna katuhv ale uhsti katuhv itsiluhkehsti itsatatvtvhvhskehsti khilo ehv utanhvhthi nanhanho itsinehsti khvnhi vtsanhiki
atanelvnho itsiyvha itsiyolihehsti
kvniyukwo itsvnvli awhi uninotena tsanhelatitoho wayhohi nahskiya'i nahski iyuhsti inatv iketsihsinahsani kehsahsti ale kuletinihskonhi iketsatanvhthi kehsehsti
tetseyhahthotsehehsti atina yvwi tekalawi'vyhenho totaketsahthinholhi tsunilaw'ihstiyinho totaketsili'vnhili
ale ayv kehsv nvtikalhstohtihskehsti nunikvwiyuhsateki ale unikvwiyuhi tunolhv ikvytilv tetsathinhohihehsti nahski unvhsv ale tsunatalenhvtv yvwi unatolehohihstohti
vtlhayheno nihi yitsinheko'i itsitotahskini utanhvhto khaneko'i nihi itstihsko'i
ahskayano totayuyohsi uyohuhihstiy tinatanhvlhi akayvlikeno uwetsi totayuyohsi ale onhi tsunathvhsvhi totvnatluthani tsunikayvlike'i ale nahski nvtvnnhihsanhi tiketsi'ihsti kehsehsti
ale nani'vkw yvwi ketsihskki kehsehsti ayv takwato'v nvtikalhstohtihskehsti ahsenho nahski kvlhskwatihski alhinikvnehi atsihstelhvhti kehsehsti

yelikwoyheno titelohkwahski tsuweyhohvhski itsulahakwo yiki ale atsinvhsitahsti unvhsitohi itsulahakwo yiki iyuyhenho tsutathinha'i atanelv kwelitsikwa yunohselv utli ahitiyu nahski itsuniwehsetiyi tutathinha'v'i
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yititsihska'ihehsti vlayeno kohuhsti yikvhskalha nahski kvnikehsv iyulhstohti nikehsvna kehsv'i vlha ale kohuhsti utelitv yiki nahski atolehohihsti nikehsvna kehsv'i
ulhsihkv itsvnetselv'i ikakathv itsi nekehsti etsatonv'elvnho kehsv kahsanali itsalihtsitohvhskehsti

ale lhehsti yititsihska'ihehsti ayelv'i anihihi ahsenho atanhvhto kvwanhihihsti nikehsvna tsiki ukvwiyuhsehstihskini etsihska'ihehsti nahski tikvwahihsti tsiki ayelv'i ale atanhvhto itsula tsvhskinho'i
lhsko anitha'li tsihskwaya hsakwo iyatanhvhthti tsunakvwalhohti yiki ahseno vlha hsakwo elati unv'ihsti yiki itsitota utanhvhthelhvhi nikehsvna
nahskwohskini itsihsthiyehkv itsihskoli nikatiyu tihselhi
nahski iyuhsti lhehsti yitsihska'ihehsti utliyhenho nika'v titsakvwalhohti nihi ehskakwo unitsathi tsihskwaya
khiloyhenho khvnikehsv nakwvnehehsti yvwi anikhathahv'i nahskwo ayv nahski khvnikehsv utatsiyvneli etota kalvlati ehi akhahthahv'i
khilohskini i'akwatayihehsti yvwi anikhahthahv'i nahskwo ayv nahski tatsiyata'yili etota kalvlati ehi akhathahv'i
lhehsti thohiyi unanukowhihsilhv elohi yihskiyelihsehehsti vlhahskini thohiyi yakinanukowhihsilhv ayelhstihskini kanvhitv
ayvyheno aki'luhtsilhv tinatahskaki iyulhstohtiyi ahskaya utotanho ale akanvki akeyv utsinho ale utatsohiya utsohinho
khilono uwahsvkwo tutathinha'v kvwahskaki kehsehsti
khilo nayihskvna ikehsehsti utseli tsutanhawatv ale nakhstawatekvna ikehsehsti vlha yeli ayv akwtseli ikvwalhstohti yikehsehsti
khilonho tetsatanilvkehsti nahski ayv takwatanilvkehsti khilnho ayv takwatanilvkehsti nahski tatanilvkehsti nvtvkinvhsvhi
hi'anho nulhsthanvki tsihsa uhskwa'tv tekhanetsehv thalatu iyanitv kvwhstawatitohi unhikihsvki nanhani tuteyho'uhsvki ale ulihtsitonhvhsvki tunitunha'v'i
nhakwonho tsani tsatsihstuhv tsuthvkanv nuhstv tulvwhihstanehv kalonetv totsunvhse anithali kvwhstawatitohi
hi'a nvtayuwehselvki nihihsko na uluhihsti tsiki tsikokhe nvwtale otsikathenohehsti'
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehselvki tsihstena tsani wi'ehstinohvhsi nika'v ihstathvkihskv'i ale ihstikowhahthihskv'i
tinikhewi anikowahthiha tiniyo'ulhinho anetoha atayhehski tsunitlvki tunatiwhska tsunili'enano anahthvkiha tsuniyohuhsvhinho tekekaletiha uyonho iyunatvnhateki ohstv khanohetv ikekalitsitonheha
ale ohsiyu iyulhstanhehti khilonititsiyotehstihskvna ikehsehsti
katokhe itsakahthanhvhse'i' ahskayahsko tiwanake tsunhuwa'i' kvniyukwo tiwanake tsunanhuwa'i unikvwiyuhi taninelv aneho'i
katokhe itsakahthanhvhse'i' atolehohskihsko' v'v itsvyohseha ale ulihiyu ehskakwo atolehohski

utohiyuhiy hi'a nitsvwehseha anikeyhv kvwaninnkowhihsvhi tsiki vlha khilo yunanukotsv kvwatalinehitehti tsani titawohski ahsenho uhstikhani kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo tsani
tsaninho titawohski unanukotsv nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi kalvlati ehi ukvwiyuhi kehsv ananeluki'eha ananelukihskinho kvhska'ihstaki taniniyiha
nani'vyhenho anatolehohski ale tikhanhawatvhsti anatolehohskvki tsani unanukotsilhv iyahsthi
iyunho tiketsatanilv'ihsti kehsehsti nahski hi'a ilaya uluhihsti tsikehsvki
khilo tekaliluhkehsti uthvkotiyi nahski athvkihskehsti
ale hi'a tsinitaniwehseho'i atselhuhki okhvhthanv tetsvnoki'elv ahseno vlha yitsalihskihsv totsiyvhkvki itsathvkoti ahsenho vlha yititsatloyhilv

uyo'iyu itsalhstanhehti kolehsini uyo'iyu itsalhstanehti kwetsayiti iyuyhenho uhskwanikohti tekalvwhihstanelv nihi itsehv yitokalvwhihstanele thaya ale hsatoni kohiki tikvwaninetliyvtv yikehse tunatanvhthv'i tsuhsihthena ytunanhuwo'e ale kohstu yunatanvliye'e'i
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha ehskkwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti thaya ale hsatoni tikukohthohtiyi ika kehsehsti utlihiyu nihi
nihino kekwani kalvlati iyvtv tsetsahsalata tsvhskinho'i wvtayelo'vhthani iyuyhenho uhskwanikti tekalvwhihstanelv nihi itsehv yitokalvwhstanele hsotamiyi ahsi khohi kehsv yinikvwhstekwo
etsena ayv hskiluhtsi nikatiyu akilhiya tihtsilvwhstanehi ale kaketv titsalhsehi ayvno tatsvyawehsolvhsthani
itsiyv akwakilhanalo ale hskiyatelhohkwahsi akwatanthiyuyhenho ale akwatatolihstiyu akinawiyi tatsiwhahthvhino titsatanto tsuyawehsolvhstiyi
akwakilhanaloyhenho nuhihsohtvna kalihsehvnho utahsahkhhiyu
nahiyu tsihsa a'ihsvki awhsv utsalehsti unatotakwahskv ika kvwhstawatitohino akonu tuniyohsihskvki ale unalenvhvki unihskutehsvki utsalehsti ale unihstikvki
ahsenho anikwalihsi unatolehohsv hi'a nvkvwawehselki kvnhiyukwo ikvtvnhehti nikehsvna unatotakwahskv ika nanatvne ketsahstawatitohi
ahseno hi'a nituwehselki lhahsko yitsikoliye'o tewi nutvnelv akonu tsuyohsihske ale nahski anehi
unelhanvhi utseli atanelv tsuyvlhe'i ale akatohti katu tsuke'i yeli kvwakihsti nikehsvna tsikehse'i ale nahski anehi atsilvhskini'anelhohi unvhsv'
tlhsko nhskwo yitsikoliye'o tikhanhawtvhstiyi nahski unatotakwahskv ika uthvna tikathawi'ihstiyi atsilv'anelhohi unatotakwahskv aniyohstihskv ale unihskanvtsvhi nikehsvna kehsv'i'
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha anhi etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo uthvna tikalawi'ihstiyi

yvwiyhenho uwetsi ukvwiyuhi nahskwo unatotakwahskv ika
nika'vhskini utlihiyu atsilvkwotiyu yvwi ehskakwo awhi unotena nahskihskini iyuhsti yelikwo ohstv tikalvwhihstanheti unatotakwahskv ika
nhakwonho hi'a nuwehselv ahskaya hatoyanvhita utoyhanvhitvkinho ale utiwhsvki nahskiya hso'i nuhstv nulhsthanvki
ahsenho tsihsa utolehohsv nanha utanvhsvki unitsathinho kvwhstawatvhsvki ale nikatv tunhvwanvki
ale tunvhstatelv khvnikehsv ikvwanhehtiyi

wahsona uyehthawotsvhi vlha tsuhskwalhsti yikehsehsti ale tholetv tsukhsvhsti vtlha uwalhatihsti yikehsehsti khvnhi atalinehitonhvha tuyukohthv kehsv tayelihihstihskv'i
ale tuto'v tsunatalenhvtv yvwi analihskahstohtihskehsti
ahsenho anikwalihsi unathvkanv hi'a nuniwehsvki hi'a vlha anihskina yitikanukowhska khvnhi tsuhstelihsko kwelitsikwa ukvwiyuhi anihskina unatselika
